vhd_scenarios.name: Offline VHD image clone and sentinel verification

vhd_scenarios.not_proved: A target that is a volume path rather than free space.

external_gates.name: System MBR-to-GPT conversion in disposable boot VM
external_gates.not_proved: Real firmware, whose boot entries a VM's do not stand for.

external_gates.name: OS migration target boot and firmware-order proof
external_gates.not_proved: A physical drive, NVMe, 4Kn, or a real firmware's boot order.

external_gates.name: UEFI boot repair with intentionally broken BCD
external_gates.not_proved: Real firmware's boot entries, which an attached-disk repair leaves alone on purpose.

external_gates.name: BIOS/MBR boot repair with intentionally broken BCD
USB removable disk destructive operation proof
external_gates.not_proved: A device Windows flags as removable: a USB hard drive reports as a fixed disk.

external_gates.name: File-level Data Recovery scan and restore proof
external_gates.not_proved: The panel's dialogs around the same engine.

external_gates.name: SSD/NVMe ReTrim proof
external_gates.not_proved: Whether the drive itself freed the blocks. TRIM's effect on flash cannot be read back: only that Windows sent it, and that nothing was lost.

external_gates.name: Direct in-app HDD defrag execution proof
external_gates.not_proved: Fragmentation dropping on any given volume: Windows decides how much it moves. That the drive spins rests on Windows reporting HDD, or on Windows reporting Unspecified and the drive itself reporting a nonzero rotation rate through smartctl. A VirtualBox disk is not accepted at all, so this row runs only on a physical device.

external_gates.name: SSD/NVMe secure erase command execution proof
external_gates.not_proved: A sanitize of the flash. This is TRIM plus an overwrite, not an ATA or NVMe sanitize, and it cannot reach what a controller has remapped.

external_gates.name: BitLocker locked/unlocked data-volume blocker proof
external_gates.not_proved: A volume whose lock state changes between the check and the write.

external_gates.name: In-app BitLocker unlock/suspend/resume mutation proof
external_gates.not_proved: A TPM protector: a data volume uses a password here.

external_gates.name: Allocate Free Space adjacent donor-volume backup/delete/extend/recreate/restore proof
external_gates.not_proved: A failure halfway, which leaves the backup for a person to restore.

external_gates.name: Offline partition start-move proof
external_gates.not_proved: That the bytes stayed put during the rebuild: the app backs up, recreates and restores, so this proves the files, not a block move.

external_gates.name: Existing-volume cluster-size change proof
external_gates.not_proved: A failure halfway, which leaves the backup for a person to restore.

external_gates.name: Primary/logical conversion on disposable MBR disk
external_gates.not_proved: A boot disk, which the app refuses here.

external_gates.name: Volume serial-number metadata mutation proof
external_gates.not_proved: A serial chosen by a person: the app reformats, and the file system picks a new one.

external_gates.name: Dynamic disk to basic conversion proof
external_gates.not_proved: A spanned or mirrored dynamic volume, which the app refuses.

external_gates.name: Non-system hardware wipe on disposable physical disk
external_gates.not_proved: Sectors a drive has remapped, and a disk too large to read back whole.
